title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12327__PART_1_)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_12327__PART_1_) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12327__PART_1_). This Indian Standard (Part 3), which is identical with ISO 8630-3 : 1987 'Information processingData interchange on 1 30 mm (5.25 in) flexible disk cartridges using modified frequency moduiation recording at 1 3 262 ftprad on 80 tracks on each side - Part 3 : Track format B for 80 tracks' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Calculators Sectional Committee (LTD 24) and approval of Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council. In the adopted standard certain terminology and conventions are not identical with those used in Indian Standards, attention is specially drawn to the following : a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, thsy should be read as 'Indian Standard'. b) Comma (,) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use a point (.) as the decimal marker. c) For the purpose of Indian Standard, metric dimensions shall be applicable. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
